reviews.comment:
La atención en el comedor , full, servicompras o como lo llamen deja en este viajero la sensación de desgano, siendo socio y recorriendo todo el país está gana en suciedades totales en los baños no siendo muy detallista al estar en ruta muchas horas , creo que una de las YPF ACA muy por debajo del umbral, la playa desbordada comprensible por ser temporada, no me pudieron hacer descuento , plateros atentos

(Translated by Google)
The service in the dining area, the convenience store, or whatever they call it, leaves this traveler with a feeling of apathy. Being a member and traveling all over the country, this is a huge plus. The bathrooms are filthy, and I'm not very observant given how long I've been on the road. I think one of the YPF ACA stations is way below standard. The beach was overflowing, understandably, given it's peak season. They couldn't give me a discount. The silver-plate attendants were inattentive.

Muy sucios los baños. Excelente la atención del chico que creo se llama Claudio pero no daba abasto en plena temporada él solo cargando el agua para cada termo, cobrando, explicando, era demasiado. Te cobran 100 pesos por el agua caliente.

(Translated by Google)
The bathrooms were filthy. The service from the guy I think was Claudio was excellent, but he was overwhelmed during peak season, carrying water to each thermos by himself, collecting payments, explaining things—it was too much. They charge 100 pesos for hot water.

reviews.comment:
Una vergüenza la higiene de los baños exteriores. No sabia que los socios disponíamos de baños impecables en el interior. De todos modos...quien por alli pasa dirá que fue a los baños del ACA  en el Bolsón y la impresión que se lleva la gente no es buena. Es un detalle a tener en cuenta. Gracias!

(Translated by Google)
The hygiene of the outdoor restrooms is a disgrace. I didn't know members had access to spotless restrooms inside. Anyway...anyone passing by will say they've been to the ACA restrooms in El Bolsón, and the impression people get isn't good. It's something to keep in mind. Thanks!
